articles.title: Rust SIMD on the GPU
articles.summary: Rust's portable SIMD on the GPU enables developers to write complex applications that leverage GPU hardware using familiar Rust abstractions. This milestone marks a significant step towards VectorWare's vision of enabling parallelism below the thread level within each warp, where scalar code adds two numbers and SIMD operations take two vectors of eight f32 values at once. Portable SIMD provides a layer of abstraction above vendor-specific intrinsics, allowing for generic vector operations that can be executed on multiple architectures.
